description: Is the LYS-1 substrate groove under selection? Conservation of cleft-lining residues vs rest of GH25 domain in the dead and active nematode clades, plus clade net charge
code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
import requests
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"})

def load_pdb(fn):
    """returns {resi: {atom: xyz}}, {resi: 3-letter}"""
    at={}; rn={}
    for ln in open(fn):
        if not ln.startswith("ATOM"): continue
        i=int(ln[22:26]); a=ln[12:16].strip()
        at.setdefault(i,{})[a]=np.array([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])])
        rn[i]=ln[17:20]
    return at,rn

BB={"N","CA","C","O","OXT"}
def sc_atoms(d):
    s=[v for k,v in d.items() if k not in BB]
    return s if s else [d["CA"]]

def cleft_positions(fn, centre_res, cutoff=10.0):
    at,rn=load_pdb(fn)
    centre=np.mean([np.mean(sc_atoms(at[r]),axis=0) for r in centre_res],axis=0)
    lining=[r for r in at if min(np.linalg.norm(x-centre) for x in sc_atoms(at[r]))<=cutoff]
    return sorted(lining), at, rn, centre

# --- define each clade reference's cleft by its own catalytic / substituted positions
lin1,at1,rn1,c1 = cleft_positions("AF-O62415.pdb", [64,154,157,260])
lin6,at6,rn6,c6 = cleft_positions("AF-Q20968.pdb", [22,112,114,209])
print(f"LYS-1 cleft-lining residues within 10 A of cleft centre: n={len(lin1)}")
print(f"LYS-6 cleft-lining residues within 10 A of cleft centre: n={len(lin6)}")

REF1=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/O62415.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")
REF6=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q20968.fasta",timeout=60).text.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")
M1=pd.read_csv("lys1clade_alignment_matrix.csv",index_col=0); M1.columns=[int(c) for c in M1.columns]
M6=pd.read_csv("lys6clade_alignment_matrix.csv",index_col=0); M6.columns=[int(c) for c in M6.columns]
cons1=pd.Series({p:(M1[p]==REF1[p-1]).mean() for p in M1.columns})
cons6=pd.Series({p:(M6[p]==REF6[p-1]).mean() for p in M6.columns})

rows=[]
for nm,cons,lin,dom in [("LYS-1 clade (n=162)",cons1,set(lin1),range(59,278)),
                        ("LYS-6 clade (n=138)",cons6,set(lin6),range(10,215))]:
    dom=[p for p in dom if p in cons.index]
    inc=cons.loc[[p for p in dom if p in lin]]; out=cons.loc[[p for p in dom if p not in lin]]
    u,pv=mannwhitneyu(inc,out,alternative="greater")
    # rank-biserial effect size
    rb=2*u/(len(inc)*len(out))-1
    rows.append(dict(clade=nm,n_cleft=len(inc),n_rest=len(out),
                     cleft_mean=round(inc.mean()*100,1),rest_mean=round(out.mean()*100,1),
                     diff_pp=round((inc.mean()-out.mean())*100,1),
                     rank_biserial=round(rb,3),p_mannwhitney=f"{pv:.3g}"))
R=pd.DataFrame(rows); R.to_csv("cleft_vs_rest_conservation.csv",index=False)
print("\nCleft-lining vs rest-of-domain conservation (one-sided Mann-Whitney)")
print(R.to_string(index=False))

# --- net charge and pI of the two clades (peptidoglycan binders are usually cationic)
seqs=json.load(open("clade_sequences.json"))
pKa={"D":3.9,"E":4.3,"C":8.3,"Y":10.1,"H":6.0,"K":10.5,"R":12.5,"nterm":8.0,"cterm":3.1}
def charge(s,pH):
    q=1/(1+10**(pH-pKa["nterm"]))-1/(1+10**(pKa["cterm"]-pH))
    for a in "KRH": q+=s.count(a)/(1+10**(pH-pKa[a]))
    for a in "DECY": q-=s.count(a)/(1+10**(pKa[a]-pH))
    return q
def pI(s):
    lo,hi=0.0,14.0
    for _ in range(60):
        mid=(lo+hi)/2
        if charge(s,mid)>0: lo=mid
        else: hi=mid
    return (lo+hi)/2
d={}
for k,lab in [("lys1_clade","LYS-1 clade"),("lys6_clade","LYS-6 clade")]:
    d[lab]=pd.DataFrame([dict(acc=a,L=len(s),pI=pI(s),q5=charge(s,5.0),q7=charge(s,7.0))
                         for a,s in seqs[k].items()])
    d[lab].to_csv(f"{k}_charge.csv",index=False)
print("\nNet charge and isoelectric point")
for lab,df in d.items():
    print(f"  {lab} (n={len(df)}): pI median {df.pI.median():.2f}, "
          f"net charge at pH 5.0 median {df.q5.median():+.1f}, at pH 7.0 median {df.q7.median():+.1f}")
u,pv=mannwhitneyu(d["LYS-1 clade"].q5,d["LYS-6 clade"].q5)
print(f"  LYS-1 vs LYS-6 clade net charge at pH 5.0: Mann-Whitney p = {pv:.3g}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.4))
for i,(nm,cons,lin,dom) in enumerate([("LYS-1 clade (n=162)",cons1,set(lin1),range(59,278)),
                                      ("LYS-6 clade (n=138)",cons6,set(lin6),range(10,215))]):
    dom=[p for p in dom if p in cons.index]
    inc=cons.loc[[p for p in dom if p in lin]]*100; out=cons.loc[[p for p in dom if p not in lin]]*100
    parts=ax[i].violinplot([out.values,inc.values],showmeans=True,widths=0.8)
    for b,c in zip(parts["bodies"],["#b8b8b8","#1f6fb2"]): b.set_facecolor(c); b.set_alpha(0.75)
    ax[i].scatter(np.random.normal(1,0.045,len(out)),out,s=5,color="#5a5a5a",alpha=0.5,zorder=3)
    ax[i].scatter(np.random.normal(2,0.045,len(inc)),inc,s=8,color="#14496f",alpha=0.8,zorder=3)
    ax[i].set_xticks([1,2]); ax[i].set_xticklabels([f"rest of domain\n(n={len(out)})",f"cleft lining\n(n={len(inc)})"])
    ax[i].set_ylabel("% identical to clade reference"); ax[i].set_ylim(0,105)
    ax[i].set_title(f"{nm}: {inc.mean():.0f}% vs {out.mean():.0f}%",loc="left",fontsize=10)
fig.suptitle("Residues lining the substrate groove are more conserved than the rest of the GH25 domain in both clades",
             fontsize=11,x=0.01,ha="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
